pop_open_priv_mo_002:
Consent to the Collection and Use of Personal Information by Korea Postal Service Agency

The Korea Postal Service Agency collects and uses visitors’ personal information as follows for the operation of the PHILAKOREA2025 World Stamp Exhibition (“the Exhibition”).
Please read the following carefully. You may participate in pre-registration and on-site check-in only if you agree.
※ Any matters not specified herein are subject to the Korea Postal Service Agency’s Privacy Policy. (https://www.posa.or.kr/)

[Consent to the Collection and Use of Personal Information]
Data Controller: Korea Postal Service Agency

Items Collected & Purpose of Use
(Required) Mobile Phone Number
To verify pre-registration, manage on-site check-in and visitor identification, provide exhibition information, conduct satisfaction and visitor surveys, and deliver rewards (including prizes).

(Required) Nickname
To identify registrants, link check-in records, track participation in programs (e.g., Stamp Tour, Treasure Hunt), collect experience data, manage participation history, and distribute rewards.

(Required) Experience Data
For reward distribution, satisfaction analysis, and statistical insights to improve future services.

Retention Period & Disposal Method
Collected information will be retained until 31 October 2025 for post-event analysis. After this date, it will be permanently deleted using irreversible methods.

Right to Refuse and Consequences
This consent is mandatory for pre-registration, on-site check-in, and entry to the Exhibition.
If you do not provide consent, you will not be able to enter the Exhibition or use related services.

home_main_001:
The moment when the world’s stamps come together
This September, a truly special experience awaits you.
home_main_002:
PHILAKOREA 2025 World Stamp Exhibition is
a global cultural festival held to commemorate the 141st anniversary of Korea Post.

At this world stamp festival, held once every ten years,
you can experience over 200,000 stamps and 2,000 stamp frames from 65 
ountries,
along with engaging side events and a variety of programs for your eyes and ears.

In the special exhibition halls of world-class rare stamps,
you will find invited works from across the globe,
rare stamp galleries rarely seen anywhere else,
theme halls, and digital experience zones.
Here, stamps become windows to the world and opportunities to connect with people everywhere.

We invite you to the world that stamps reveal.

home_main_003: At this world stamp festival, held once every ten years,you can experience over 200,000 stamps and 2,000 stamp frames from 65 countries,along with engaging side events and a variety of programs for your eyes and ears.

home_main_space_027: The Pinnacle of Global Stamp Art
home_main_space_029: Authentic Local Products, Handpicked by Korea Post
space_detail_003: Heritage of the Times, Revived Through Stamps
space_detail_004: Stamps are more than simple records—they encapsulate the cultural heritage of their time within a small square frame. Explore the deeper meaning and emotion of Korea's intangible cultural assets through stamp designs and physical exhibits that bring history to life.
space_detail_006: Timeless Art Born from the Artist’s Touch
space_detail_007: Stamps become a new canvas in the hands of artists. This space showcases limited-edition “eternal stamps” created in collaboration with artists, alongside sculptural works inspired by them. Experience an artistic expansion where original paintings and actual stamps coexist in harmony.
space_detail_010: From K-pop and musicals to characters and cuisine, Korea’s vibrant culture—admired worldwide—takes new form through stamps. With immersive videos, vivid visuals, and curated commentary, this space offers a rich, multisensory journey into the world of K-Culture.
space_detail_013:
Letters are one of the warmest bridges between people.
Through the award-winning works of the 2025 Letter-Writing Contest, story-filled stamps, and famous letters from history, we share the timeless emotions and resonance carried by a single letter.
space_detail_016: Stamps serve as quiet windows into the natural world, delivering messages of conservation. This exhibit features stamp designs inspired by national monuments and endangered species, along with real plant displays, to emphasize the importance of biodiversity and sustainable ecosystems.
space_detail_018: A Designer’s Eye, Framed in Stamps
space_detail_019: Discover the artistic philosophies and visual techniques of stamp designers through previously unreleased original artworks and sketches.Under the theme Design Movements, this exhibition traces the evolution of design trends and experimental spirit across eras.
space_detail_021: To mark the 141th anniversary of the Korean postal service, this exhibit presents stamps that reflect the nation’s modern history—from art and sports to diplomacy and nature. Trace 141 years of Korea’s story, beautifully captured on pieces of paper.
space_detail_024: Stories of the World in One Stamp
space_detail_025: Choose the stamp that captures your attention from among many, and discover the history, culture, and stories it carries. A single stamp unfolds into a journey across the world—experience it for yourself.
space_detail_028: AI analyzes your facial expression to recommend a stamp that mirrors your current emotion—joy, surprise, calm, and more. This fusion of data and emotion helps uncover subtle feelings you may not have noticed before.
space_detail_030: The Further You Focus, the Farther It Flies
space_detail_031: Measure your brainwaves to assess concentration, then launch a virtual letter as far as your focus allows. A playful, visual experience of the abstract power of attention—for both kids and adults.
space_detail_033: Drawn by a Robot, Inspired by You
space_detail_034: AI-powered robotics recognizes your face in real time and sketches your portrait onto a stamp-shaped canvas. Experience precise, delicate lines forming a one-of-a-kind portrait you can take home.
space_detail_037: Draw freely on a touchscreen as AI adjusts the background, tones, and style to blend your art with others’. Every gesture becomes part of a growing, collaborative masterpiece—a creative experiment in shared expression.
space_detail_039: Turn Your Face into a Stamp
space_detail_040: AI captures your face and seamlessly merges it into a stamp frame—creating your own personalized portrait stamp. More than a photo, it’s a modern philatelic experience blending identity and design.
space_detail_043: The character inside the stamp appears to speak to you—‘The Talking Stamp’. Experience a new philatelic journey of the digital age, where still images come to life with voice.
space_detail_046_1: A collaborative artwork where everyone contributes doodles on a giant stamp wall.
space_detail_047_1: Create your own doodle on the giant stamp wall! Small drawings and messages come together to create one grand piece.
space_detail_046_2: A special letter that is delivered slowly, on the day you choose.
space_detail_047_2: Write a heartfelt letter today! It will arrive slowly on your chosen date, creating a truly memorable moment.
space_detail_046:
Color, Create, and Make 
 Your Own Special Stamp
space_detail_047:
The joy of drawing and creating with your own hands!
Complete your very own work at the always-open “Stamp Doodle,” “141st Anniversary Commemorative Stamp Drawing,” and “Slow Letter” experiences.
space_detail_064: The Pinnacle of Global Stamp Art
space_detail_066: From traditional philately to thematic collections, illustrated postcards, and youth entries—explore top-tier stamp exhibits submitted by collectors worldwide.Go beyond collecting to discover the artistic value of each miniature masterpiece.
space_detail_070: Experience the taste and style of Korea’s diverse regions— featuring local produce and small business products handpicked by Korea Post. Trustworthy delivery and meaningful curation come together to highlight the true value of regional Korea.
space_detail_073: Unique Stamps from Around the World
space_detail_074: Explore some of the world’s rarest stamps gathered in one place. Witness history, culture, and the finest printing techniques captured in these delicate, decades-old sheets. Step into the rich and profound world of stamp collecting.

tre_detail_type_002: Please select the topic you want.
tre_detail_result_trd1_004: Seek the pride of New Zealand’s postal heritage in the face of Zealandia, who crossed imperial seas with the vision of uniting the world under a single postage rate.
tre_detail_result_trd2_004: Follow the stamp bearing a tribal seal atop Ottoman traces, marking the beginning of a new tradition in the land of Hejaz.
tre_detail_result_trd3_004: Look for the classic Danish stamp—its disciplined design and sharp edges embody the order and authority of the royal family, marking the start of Nordic postal tradition.
tre_detail_result_trd4_004: The first stamp ever to bear the name “Republic of Korea”—the treasure lies at the starting point of Korea’s journey after liberation.
tre_detail_result_trd5_004: Trace the revival of indigenous identity through printing and design—Bolivia’s stamps reflect the restoration of tradition after a colonial past.
tre_detail_result_hty1_004: Explore the first voice of a newly liberated nation through stamps issued between 1946 and 1950—just before the outbreak of war.
tre_detail_result_hty2_004: Discover the maritime postal route that linked Brazil and Portugal across the vast Atlantic, carrying hope and news in every letter.
tre_detail_result_hty3_004: Through two world wars and an era of colonial rule, find traces of repression and resilience in censored stamps that carried messages through turbulent times.
tre_detail_result_hty4_004: Uncover the authority and sentiment of a monarchy in transition, captured in stamps and letters from the twilight of an empire.
tre_detail_result_hty5_004: Under the fading light of empire, follow the delicate prints and overprints that reflect Hungary’s royal dignity and steadfast resolve in early 20th-century stamps.
tre_detail_result_thm1_004: Explore a chronicle of birds—their habitats, their mysteries, and the wonder of nature hidden beneath their feathers.
tre_detail_result_thm2_004: Discover the essence of ballet—graceful as a swan on stage, yet stirring without wings—captured in stamps.
tre_detail_result_thm3_004: Find a scene in time as seen through a pharmacist’s eyes—from bitter medicines to bold defenses—recording humanity’s fight against illness.
tre_detail_result_thm4_004: Uncover stamps that reflect society’s earliest efforts to prevent accidents and protect lives in an era when small mistakes could mean great disaster.
tre_detail_result_thm5_004: Step into the fantastical—where mythical creatures and vivid colors bring imagined worlds to life within the frame of a stamp.
tre_detail_result_avt1_004: In the 1920s, the first era of airmail began in the Dutch East Indies. Discover the flow of traditional aviation between colony and homeland through local patterns and airplane silhouettes.
tre_detail_result_avt2_004: With the outbreak of World War II, Argentina’s airmail routes stretched faster and farther. Trace the enduring journeys of flight that continued even amid war.
tre_detail_result_avt3_004: Founded in 1919, SCADTA was Latin America’s first civilian airline. Follow the airmail history across the Panama Isthmus, where planes flew with the rhythm of the sea.
tre_detail_result_avt4_004: In 1911, the world’s first continuous airmail service took off in Britain. Look for a soaring moment in history where celebration met the silhouette of winged addresses.
tre_detail_result_avt5_004: Explore the traces of pioneering and special flights launched in Honduras. Follow the adventurous journeys that once crossed the skies of Central America, now preserved in stamps.
tre_detail_result_pht1_004: From 1881 to 1936, follow the journey of Vietnam’s railway as it grew and transformed under French colonial rule. Find the stamp that captures this historic passage.
tre_detail_result_pht2_004: Beyond red doors and spice-scented alleys, discover the lives and landscapes of Zanzibar, preserved in the frame of a single stamp.
tre_detail_result_pht3_004: Seek the quiet golden moments printed on aged postcards—snapshots of Herceg Novi’s alleys and seaside from a time long past.
tre_detail_result_pht4_004: Journey into Bangladesh’s rivers and forests to find the stamp that captures traces of wildlife and landscapes painted by nature itself.
tre_detail_result_pht5_004: Along the railroad tracks, uncover scenes of longing from the first 20 years of Novska, captured through the lens of a stamp.
tre_detail_result_yth1_004: The clumsy dreams and wild imaginations once hidden inside you—now reborn as tiny, endearing monsters. Find the stamp that reflects your younger self.
tre_detail_result_yth2_004: While others run, you choose to walk—like Titan the donkey. Seek the stamp that celebrates going slow yet staying true to yourself.
tre_detail_result_yth3_004: Recall the days of heartfelt handwriting, when sincerity spoke louder than words. Find the stamp that feels like a postcard from that time.
tre_detail_result_yth4_004: Like the legend of a stone that grants courage, seek the stamp that helps unspoken truths find their voice.
tre_detail_result_yth5_004: More precious than a glittering tree was the anticipation and thrill within. Find the stamp that rekindles those long-lost feelings.
